name: @synapcores/telemetry-bridge
description: DCU bridge for the aerospace-rca U6 demo. WebSocket ingest from a 3K-sensor / 100Hz simulator, per-sensor ring buffer + Welford rolling stats + z-score / step / debounce detection, batched 1Hz aggregate INSERTs into SynapCores AIDB, alert promotion into the U1 anomalies table with EMBED().
